# Clarvix Core (Clarvix Web)

> Clarvix Core is a managed action website for small service businesses in Israel. The current product is ABD: A = Build First, B = Action Website, D = Smart Request. Clarvix creates a limited personalized preview before payment, builds the website around one primary action, and prepares a structured WhatsApp request in the visitor's browser.

Language of the live site: Hebrew (he-IL). Service area: Israel. The service is business-to-business by default.

## Current offer

- Personalized preview: free, limited, temporary and non-public.
- Monthly: ₪500 activation and setup plus ₪200 per month, with an initial 12-month commitment. First-year total: ₪2,900.
- Annual: ₪2,200 paid in advance for 12 months, including activation and setup. Saving versus monthly in year one: ₪700.
- Private project / no portfolio use: ₪500 one time.
- Clarvix currently operates as an Israeli VAT-exempt dealer (עוסק פטור), so VAT is not charged. If the status changes, legally applicable VAT will be added to future charges under the agreement.

## Included

- One action website with up to seven content sections plus required legal pages.
- One primary action and one alternative action.
- Smart Request with up to six questions, two simple branches and one WhatsApp destination.
- One primary language, mobile-first Hebrew and RTL support.
- One standard domain registered with the client as legal holder from day one.
- Hosting, SSL, deployment, monitoring and technical defect correction while Core is active.
- Basic event measurement without Smart Request answers or form text.
- Two consolidated revision rounds before launch.

## Domain model

Clarvix uses one central registrar account to register, pay, renew and technically administer production domains. The client is recorded as the legal domain holder from the first day. Clarvix may be payer and administrative/technical contact, but does not own the client's domain. Clarvix-owned domains and clarvix.net subdomains are used only for previews and temporary environments. On exit, Clarvix coordinates transfer and provides relevant DNS information.

## Not included

- There is no monthly change allowance. New copy, design, pages, languages, integrations or structural changes are quoted separately and require approval.
- Branding, photography, video, custom illustration, ecommerce, payments, booking, CRM, bots, WhatsApp API, ongoing SEO, campaigns, corporate email and third-party subscriptions are not included.
- Clarvix Control (C) and Clarvix Trust (E) are future optional modules and are not promised or included in Core.
- No quantity of leads, sales or search ranking is guaranteed.

## Privacy and accessibility

Smart Request works locally in the browser by default and does not store answers on Clarvix servers. Optional Google and Meta measurement loads only after an explicit privacy choice. Clarvix currently operates as an עוסק פטור and publishes a self-exemption accessibility statement while maintaining an accessible baseline and an alternative contact channel.
